question: nearest country to -150 30
sql: SELECT name, iso_a3, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(ST_Point(-150.0, 30.0), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 1;

question: 5 countries closest to Nile
sql: SELECT c.name, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c, rivers r WHERE r.name = 'Nile' ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 5;

question: rivers within 500km Vatican
sql: SELECT r.name, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c, rivers r WHERE c.name = 'Vatican' AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(c.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), 500000) ORDER BY dist_km;

question: 5 nearest countries France
sql: SELECT c2.name, ST_Distance_Sphere(ST_Centroid(c1.geometry), ST_Centroid(c2.geometry)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c1, countries c2 WHERE c1.name = 'France' AND c2.name != 'France' ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 5;

question: longest river per continent
sql: SELECT cont.continent, r.name, r.length_km FROM (SELECT DISTINCT continent FROM countries) cont CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r2.name, ST_Length_Spheroid(r2.geometry) / 1000 AS length_km FROM rivers r2 JOIN countries c2 ON ST_Intersects(r2.geometry, c2.geometry) WHERE c2.continent = cont.continent ORDER BY length_km DESC LIMIT 1) r ORDER BY r.length_km DESC;

question: country pairs within 100km
sql: SELECT c1.name AS country1, c2.name AS country2, ST_Distance(ST_Transform(c1.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(c2.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true)) / 1000 AS dist_km FROM countries c1, countries c2 WHERE c1.iso_a3 < c2.iso_a3 AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(c1.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), ST_Transform(c2.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true), 100000) ORDER BY dist_km LIMIT 10;
